note: Scripted problems the simulated day uses when it tries to involve the judge's own person (Settings → You). Each is asked by a simulated requester (the requester is never asked, so choosing it steers who is eligible); `targets` lists the directory names the question reached on a freshly reset demo database (the real coordinator still decides, and limits, cooldowns and earlier answers can change the pick). '*' = whoever the coordinator picks. All synthetic; no real people.
